NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a regular meeting of the Alhambra Housing and
Community Development Citizen Advisory (HCDA) Committee will be held on
Tuesday, September 1, 2026, commencing at 6:30 pm, at Alhambra City Hall,
Conference Room A, 2nd Floor, 111 South First Street, Alhambra CA, pursuant to

 4. REVIEW OF HCDA CITIZEN ADVISORY COMMITTEE MEETING START
  TIME

  Requested at the May 5, 2026, HCDA Citizen Advisory Committee meeting, the
  Committee will discuss whether to change the start time of future meetings from
  6:30 p.m. to either 5:30 p.m. or 6:00 p.m.

5. DRAFT 2025–2026 CAPER

  The Housing and Community Development Citizens Advisory Committee will
  receive input on City programs funded with Housing and Urban Development
  Funds. This CAPER is for the first year of the FY 2025 - FY 2029 Consolidated
  Plan. It is a review the City's specific achievement in FY 2025-2026 (July 1, 2025
  through June 30, 2026) and an assessment of the progress in implementing the
  goals and objectives of the five-year Consolidated Plan.

  Comments and insight from the audience and members will be submitted to the
  City Council for the Public Hearing regarding the 2025-2026 CAPER scheduled
  for September 14, 2026.

6. STAFF UPDATES

  Discussion from the Staff Members of any item(s) not specified on the
  agenda. Items discussed must pertain the business of the HCDA Citizen
  Advisory Committee.

7. COMMENTS FROM THE AUDIENCE

  Discussion from the public of any items not specified on the agenda.
  Comments must pertain to the business of the HCDA Citizen Advisory
  Committee. Public comments pertaining to the HCDA Citizen Advisory
  Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete a speak card prior to the meeting and
  submit the card to the Committee’s Secretary.

8. COMMENTS AND CONCERNS FROM THE COMMITTEE

  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the
  agenda. Items discussed must pertain the business of the HCDA Citizen
  Advisory Committee.

9. ADJOURNMENT
 Copies of the staff report or other written documentation relating to each item of
business described herein are on file in the Office of Management Services,
Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street, Alhambra, CA, and are available for
public inspection during regular office hours from 7:00 am to 5:30: PM, Monday
through Thursday.

Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior
the meeting, the person may contact Esteban Alvarez in the Management Services
Department in person at City Hall or at 626.570.5012 during regular business hours.

2. APPROVAL OF MINUTES: April 7, 2026

  City Staff Liaison Alvarez presented the minutes for the April 7, 2026 meeting.

  Motion: Motion from Chair McCammon to move for approval of the minutes for April 7,
  2026, and second from Committee Member Giese. All in favor of approval.

3. PROGRESS REPORTS

  City Staff Liaison Alvarez presented an oral report on the year-to-date progress of the Senior
  Case Management, Code Enforcement, Housing Rights Center, and Home Improvement
  programs.

  Motion: Motion was made for approval from Chair McCammon, seconded by Committee
  Member Cardenas, all Committee members in approval of receiving and filling the reports.

4. REVIEW OF THE DRAFT 2026–2027 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN

  The Committee reviewed the Draft 2026–2027 Annual Action Plan and discussed the NOFA,
  PLHA funds, Measure A funds, homeless services, the use of publicly owned land to address
  housing needs, updates to tenant protections, the density bonus, the CHDO reserve, HOME
  Match requirements, and down payment assistance.

  Motion: Motion from Committee Cember Giese to move for approval, and second from Vice
  Chair Armas. All in favor of approval.

 5. STAFF UPDATES

  Staff provided an update on the status of the section 108 loan, that is still pending approval

  None.

  The Committee expressed interest in changing the start time of the HCDA meetings from

  September 1, 2026 meeting.

  in favor of closing the meeting.
